cover_letter:
Dear Hopper Hiring Team,

As an AI-Native Principal Product Manager with 8+ years of experience building 0-to-1 B2B digital products and developer-facing API workflows, I am thrilled to apply for the Principal Product Manager — HTS API Marketplace role at Hopper.

My working style is inherently AI-first. I leverage LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT), low-code tools, and vibe coding daily to build functional mockups, test API responses, and validate partner workflows before committing engineering resources. Reaching for a prototype before a PRD is second nature to me.

Technically, I bring a unique dual background: 2.5 years of Engineering studies (UTFPR/UFPR) combined with a B.A. in Philosophy (UFPR). This allows me to query databases with SQL, understand complex API capability surfaces (like connectivity, pricing, and content mapping), and translate them into clear, enterprise-grade product specifications and documentation.

In my recent experience, I conceived and launched 0-to-1 API-integrated products (such as the Meu Barzin Pass MVP integrated with WhatsApp API and Stripe), governed enterprise onboarding and enablement at Wipro/Meta (reducing ramp-up by 50%), and managed product roadmaps across multidisciplinary teams.

Fluent in English and operating 100% remotely, I am eager to help build the HTS API Marketplace into a category-defining commercial platform.

Best regards,
Kevin Augusto Vieira

form_answers.question: How do you use AI tools and vibe coding in your daily Product Management workflow?
form_answers.answer:
AI is my primary tool for rapid prototyping and validation:
1. API & Workflow Mocking: I use Claude and ChatGPT to quickly generate mock API JSON payloads, test response structures, and simulate partner onboarding portals.
2. Discovery & Data Synthesis: I process unstructured qualitative feedback and ticket data with LLMs to extract feature requirements and drop-off patterns.
3. Documentation & Specs: I draft API documentation, user stories, and acceptance criteria using AI, reducing iteration cycles before engineering handoff.

form_answers.question: Describe a 0-to-1 API or developer-facing product you built and commercially launched.
form_answers.answer: At Meu Barzin, I led the 0-to-1 concept, design, and launch of a recurring subscription pass integrated directly with the official WhatsApp API and Stripe payment webhooks. I defined the commercial packaging, mapped partner establishment workflows, created sandbox testing routines, and analyzed deep-funnel drop-offs (identifying a 43.9% API latency bottleneck) to optimize partner conversion.
